label: How it works
heading: Up and running in four steps
description: From choosing a service to running your own branded workspace, our team is with you at every step.

service.title: Choose a service
service.description: Pick the service that fits your operations, whether it's available now or coming soon.

plan.title: Choose a plan
plan.description: Select the plan that matches your branches, or register your interest in an upcoming service.

contact.title: We contact you
contact.description: Our team reaches out to answer your questions, finalize the details and confirm your payment.

activate.title: Activate your brand
activate.description: Upload your logo, choose your brand colors and take over as your brand's admin.
